description.narrative: The objective of the grant is to develop a robust Adolescent Girls Unit at the Ministry of Gender & Development to ensure national programs and policies are optimized to work better for girls in order to accelerate growth and reduce poverty in Liberia. Girls have a unique potential to end poverty and this Unit would work to actualize that potential. The overall expected outcome is improved programming for adolescent girls nationwide. Through coordinated capacity-buildingcomma planningcomma implementationcomma monitoringcomma and advocacycomma the Adolescent Girls Unit will ensure that adolescent girls get the attention they deserve and remain at the forefront of Liberia's development agenda. The grant will support the following components: Component 1: Establishing the Adolescent Girls Unit This component focuses on establishing the Adolescent Girls Unit within the Ministry of Gender and Development and equipping it with a library and computer lab that can be accessed by adolescent girls programming practitioners and adolescent girls. The library and computer lab will be an important resource for adolescent girls practitioners and adolescent girls as it will be a place where they will be able to find materials and information on programs that focus on adolescent girlscomma training materials and trainingcomma and also employment and training information. Component 2: Improving Capacity for Adolescent Girls Programming A number of organizations are working with adolescent girls in Liberia. Howevercomma there is a need to coordinate effortscomma strengthen capacity to develop and implement programscomma and increase the quality of adolescent girls programs. This component will also support the initial assessments to scale-up the EPAG project currently being implemented by the Ministry of Gender and Development and a toolkit that captures the lessons learned from this program. Component 3: Raising Awareness of Adolescent Girls' Issues and Programs Raising awareness of issues affecting adolescent girls is needed in order to strengthen policies and programs. This component will also support mentoring of young girls through the use of girl clubs in local communities.
